ROW.COLUMN: (FR/AC) Excessive Debit / Bank Card Purchase Activity

Excessive purchase activity associated with a Bank/Debit card may indicate attempts to perpetrate fraud or account takeover. For example, an employee or hacker who obtains access of a customer's Bank/Debit card information could use this information to process fraudulent purchases. This scenario monitors recent Bank/Debit card transactions to detect a significant increase in purchase activity when compared to historical activity determined over a configurable Lookback Period. This scenario also considers the number of distinct locations where the Bank/Debit card was accessed, if such data is available.

Primary Rule fetches all the accounts engaged in Excessive debit card purchase.1st subrule retrieves all the relevant cash transactions.2nd sub-rule retrieves latest date for that account in Account balance.
